## What's Changed
* refactor: improve handling of multipart content by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2666
* refactor: eliminated unused code by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2667
* refactor: Use canonical optionality for XML attributes by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2668
* Honor nullable JSON responses by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2671
* fix: Preserve null literals outside JSON bodies by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2672
* Mark multipart image upload conformance as passing by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2673
* Fix example module discovery and stable IDs for inline examples by @StarKhan6368 in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2664
* fix: fix bcc mcp tool in case of docker by @vedubhat in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2675
* Preserve default response reporting in test coverage by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2676
* Handle response examples without matching request examples by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2677
* Add OpenID Connect security scheme support by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2683
* Handle 429 responses in non-4xx contract tests by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2682
* Support retries for undocumented 429 responses by @joelrosario in https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/pull/2684


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/specmatic/specmatic/compare/2.51.1...2.52.0
